hero.h1: Fitnex: personal training and online fitness coaching with Sharry.
hero.lede: Strength coach, in person and online. I help people feel capable in their own body. We start where you are and build from there.
hero.art: Illustration of a coach holding a kettlebell

about.art: Illustration of a coach holding a clipboard and waving
about.title: Hi, I’m Sharry.
about.lede: I started lifting to get through a hard year, and found out that getting stronger changes far more than your body. Now I help other people find that feeling.
about.body: My clients are busy. Some are rebuilding after an injury or a pregnancy, some want to lift their first real weight, some just want to stop feeling stiff. They all want a plan that makes sense, and someone in their corner who notices the small wins.
rules: Technique before load. Every rep is practice.
Progress you can measure, not punishment you can feel.
Training fits your life. Not the other way round.

services.title: Ways to train with me
services.intro: Choose one or mix them. Most clients start with personal training and move online later.

items.title: Personal training
items.text: One-to-one sessions in a private studio. Full attention on your technique, your pace and your goals.

items.title: Online coaching
items.text: Your programme in an app, wherever you train. I review your lifts on video and adjust the plan every week.

items.title: Small group strength
items.text: Up to four people, one coach. Coached like personal training, with the energy of training together.

items.title: Nutrition and habits
items.text: No meal plans and no banned foods. We build a few simple habits around protein, sleep and energy.

items.title: Strength
items.text: Squat, hinge, push, pull and carry. The basic patterns that make everyday life feel lighter.
items.art: Illustration of a person pressing a barbell overhead

items.title: Mobility
items.text: Range you can actually use. We open up stiff hips, shoulders and backs, then make that range strong.
items.art: Illustration of a person in a yoga tree pose on a mat

items.title: Conditioning
items.text: Fitness that lasts. Short, structured intervals that improve how fast you recover.
items.art: Illustration of a person skipping with a jump rope

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Send me a message about your goals, your history and your week. No pressure to sign up.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: We test how you move, where you’re strong and what needs care. This is your starting line.

steps.title: Your plan
steps.text: A programme written for you, with sessions that fit the time you really have.

steps.title: Train and review
steps.text: We train, check in every week and re-test every six. You’ll see your progress in the numbers.

items.q: I’ve never trained before. Is that okay?
items.a: Yes, and it’s one of my favourite places to start. We’ll learn each movement properly before adding any weight.
In-person sessions take place at a studio that I arrange. Online clients train wherever suits them, at a gym or at home, with minimal equipment.

items.q: Do I need to change my diet?
items.a: Not unless you want to. If you do, the nutrition plan focuses on simple habits, not meal plans or counting everything.
Yes. You can cancel at the end of your current booked period, as long as you let me know in advance.
